title: Hijack
synopsis: Seven hours from Singapore to London. Row 18. Aisle. You're a corporate negotiator on holiday. They picked the wrong plane.

nodes.text: Wheels up. You order tomato juice. The man in 18B is, you notice, sweating.

choices.consequence: “Engage him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Test.
“Watch him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Read.

nodes.text: A flight attendant goes pale at the galley curtain. You realize something has shifted at the front.

choices.consequence: “Move forward” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Act.
“Stay seated” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wait.

nodes.text: The lead flight attendant is competent. She uses careful eye contact. You realize she is already negotiating.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pair up—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Don't crowd—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: An announcement: 'Stay seated.' Two men in business class are armed. The demand is, unusually, specific. They want a name in Singapore released.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Information.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: People.

nodes.text: An off-duty doctor in 18C catches your eye. She has, you can tell, training you don't.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Coordinate with her.” The story records the instinct as “Allies” and carries it forward.
“Don't expose her” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Protect.

nodes.text: You have a satellite phone in your bag. You can, with one text, reach your firm's security desk.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Use it—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Save the phone for later” back. Hold shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The pilots are, by the schedule, still in there. The door is, by the schedule, still closed.

choices.text: Talk to the FA about the door
choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Strategy.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Don't push—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The men in business class let you, eventually, speak with them. You are, in their words, 'the calm one.'

choices.consequence: “Lower their adrenaline” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Defuse.
You commit to “Stall for the ground.” The story records the instinct as “Time” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The name they want is, you realize, a man your firm has briefed you on. The story is, in places, more complicated than the demand suggests.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Use that knowledge.” The story records the instinct as “Leverage” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Don't reveal what you know.” The story records the instinct as “Hide” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: A child cries. The doctor calms him. A businessman across the aisle has, against your judgement, decided he can take the smaller man.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Prevent.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Use.

nodes.text: Ground control, finally, is on the line. The negotiator on the other end is in their forties and exhausted.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Two fronts.
“Stay focused on the cabin” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: One front.

nodes.text: The men are tiring. They have, you notice, planned for this hour. They have not, you notice, planned for hour five.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Patience—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Force a small concession” back. Pressure shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: An older passenger needs the bathroom. The smaller man refuses. The older passenger, eventually, doesn't ask twice.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Mercy—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Let the moment pass” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Don't escalate.

nodes.text: The doctor whispers: one of the men is, by her medical eye, in a hypoglycemic spiral. She suggests, casually, food.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Soften him.
You commit to “Save it for later.” The story records the instinct as “Hold” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The plan, you realize, was always to land somewhere — not London. They need to know they can land. You realize you can offer that.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Trade—follows you into whatever comes next.

choices.text: Don't trade until you have to
choices.consequence: You commit to “Don't trade until you have to.” The story records the instinct as “Hold” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The captain's voice, through the door, is steady. He asks, professionally, for guidance. You give it.

choices.text: Tell him the truth about the cabin
choices.consequence: “Tell him the truth about the cabin” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Trust him.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Compartmentalize—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The plane diverts to a smaller airport. The men, on the ground, are no longer airborne — which is itself a kind of defeat.

choices.text: Push for the door to open peacefully
choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Quiet.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Patience.

nodes.text: The cockpit door opens, finally, with the men's permission. The pilots, professional, do not, in the cockpit, react.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Care.

choices.text: Step back and let them work
choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Trust.

nodes.text: The negotiator on the ground signals you. The men set down their weapons. Nobody fires.

choices.text: Bring the cabin to its feet quietly
choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Order—follows you into whatever comes next.

choices.text: Stay in your seat as instructed
choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Comply.

nodes.text: The doors open onto a tarmac that smells of jet fuel and rain. The passengers, in a long line, walk out. You and the doctor and the flight attendant are last.

choices.consequence: Friendship of seven hours.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Process privately.

nodes.text: You stand in a small airport's corridor with foil blankets and bad coffee. You realize you can choose, right now, what kind of person this flight made you.

choices.consequence: Use the skill.
Get off the road.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You leave corporate and join an international crisis-response team. You log many more hours like flight 72. You sleep well in the after, but you never quite love a plane again.
You take a quieter job. You write a memo about cabin tactics that gets distributed to every flight attendant in Europe. Nobody knows your name. Many people are alive because of you.
You stay in touch with the doctor and the flight attendant for the rest of your life. You become, in a real sense, family. You have, you realize, met your people.
